evidence.echo_primary_path: PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue lines 257-290: `subscribeEcho()` wires `branch.{id}` channel + 2 listeners (`OrderCreated` + `OrderStatusChanged`) via `onEvents`. On WS event, immediately fires `this.list()` to re-fetch. De-duplication via `_echoMarkedReady` Set (AUDIT-P1).
evidence.polling_fallback: OssSyncService.js DEFAULTS — intervalMsWhenConnected=60_000ms (passive heartbeat), intervalMsWhenDisconnected=2_000ms (tight fallback when WS down). Visibility burst-poll on tab regain (1s throttle).
evidence.cadence_safety: CADENCE_CEILING_MS=60_000 / CADENCE_FLOOR_MS=250 prevents owner misconfig (e.g. FK_CATALOG_OSS_FALLBACK_CONNECTED_INTERVAL_MS=999999999) from freezing the wall — Wave 3c KDS-ADV3C-08 P1 heal.
evidence.backoff_5xx: On 500-class response, OssSyncService.js `_handle5xx` doubles backoff starting at 5000ms capped at 30000ms (backoffStartMs + backoffCapMs).
evidence.tests_passed: tests/js/orderStatusScreenOssSync.spec.js (1/1), tests/js/ossChimePublicWall.spec.js (7/7), tests/js/ossWakeLockOnMount.spec.js (6/6), tests/js/ossSyncFallback.spec.js (3/3), tests/js/posOssCadenceCap.spec.js (11/11) — 27/27 GREEN.

synchronization_architecture.primary_path: Laravel Echo → Pusher → `branch.{id}` channel → `OrderStatusChanged` event broadcast. Handler in PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue line 264-290 receives event, fires `this.list()` immediate refetch.
synchronization_architecture.fallback_path: OssSyncService.js polling: 60s when WS connected (heartbeat-only — Echo does the work), 2s when WS disconnected. Tab-regain burst-poll throttled at 1s.
synchronization_architecture.after_commit_safety: OrderStatusChanged uses DispatchableAfterCommit (gate C9 — KI-001) — broadcast deferred until DB::transaction() commits, dropped on rollback. No phantom OSS reactions to rolled-back transactions.
synchronization_architecture.queue_safety: TZ invariant documented: `now('UTC')->subHours(8)` for stale-prune is UTC-bound; `Carbon::today(app.timezone)` for today-window is Paris-local. Sister coverage SisterServicesTzAwareTest + SisterServicesTzAwareV2Test (10 cases PASS).

info.description: MEMORY.md and Wave Polish Final CONVERGENCE_FINAL.md report a 5.4s POS-deliver→OSS-clear figure. That number is from a full Playwright spec (`tests/e2e/wave-polish-final-B.spec.js` Scenario 2) which includes UI navigation, click handlers, OSS page load + polling RTT. The C3 measurement here mutates DB + dispatches event in-process then polls the public API directly — pure architectural ceiling — yielding 95-150ms. Both numbers are correct under their respective methodologies.

Echo primary + polling fallback architecture intact with cadence floor/ceiling safeguards (V3.5). 8/8 PHPUnit OSS filter + 14/14 polish/TZ + 28/28 Vitest OSS = 50/50 unit-level coverage GREEN.
